archive.contents: Frozen six-process recipe,packages,configuration,qualification,individual clocks and actual provider/owner/fault evidence.

question: Does NEO alone explain the original6e40 decline from1003 to974tok/s?

plan.question: Does NEO alone explain the original6e40 decline from1003 to974tok/s?
plan.constants: Same original6e40 binary,1256-slot decode layout,131072 resident INT8 context,8192 chunks, BF16/vLLM/mode10,384 packed expert bank,Q8 MTP,5 CPU workers,all safety settings. One short warmup then four117489-token thinking-on requests,24 output tokens,no prefix reuse.
plan.gate: Before long model work,both private driver arms pass original submission,graph0 and graph1 fixtures with pre-main parameter/API validation,numerical/guard markers,actual mapped NEO, normal owned exit and no fresh fault. Stop first failure,no retry.
plan.decision: Six independent processes,new/old/old/new/new/old. Keep first use separate. Use subsequent-three median;old faster requires all three old/new ratios>1 and geomean>=1.01; new faster analogously. Otherwise unresolved. No speed-based stop or replacement. Commit every closed outcome before advancing. No inference or runtime adoption.
plan.measurement: Official bench.sh --prefill-only --prefill-tokens98304 --think --runs4 with identical request gates and client in both arms. Engine clock is unchanged original6e40/libstdc++, qualified65536-pair endpoint records remain in both historical cohorts;requests>=10000ms. Warning-only parameter validation and retained-loader preload charged to both. No profiler,census,timer,state readbacks or resource sampling.
plan.limits: Only NEO varies. Current GMM/IGC/zlib/loader/kernel remain;this does not reproduce the entire historical stack. Explicit alternative driver selection is applied to BOTH arms before exec and observed from maps. No system install,service change,reset or reboot.

environment_reference.shared_override: Warning-only parameter validation writes to a private per-process file. Both arms explicitly set ZE_ENABLE_ALT_DRIVERS before exec;only private NEO bytes differ. Qualified safety settings preserved.

runtime_reference.other_dependencies_held: Current GMM,IGC,IGDML,zlib,UR/SYCL,oneMKL and loader;not the complete historical stack.

analysis.limits: NEO-only crossover with current GMM/IGC/zlib/kernel held fixed;not the entire historical stack, hardware saturation,decode speed,driver adoption or ordinary-runtime-teardown qualification.

selection.decision: Neither predeclared faster screen passes. Old NEO alone does not reproduce historical1003tok/s under current other dependencies;this does not prove no NEO effect or exclude runtime interactions. Preserve all samples including967/965tok/s observations.
selection.next: Audit selected6e40 owned128 versus borrowed1256 prefill placement under current runtime and prepare a new phase-specific diagnostic plan. Smaller-cache arm is a reference only;production decode stays1256. Measure hardware waits/capacity before selecting a new implementation.

limits: Historical cohorts have a real observed difference but are not a contemporaneous causal comparison.
24-token outputs do not qualify decode,task quality or agent sessions.
No hardware saturation or limiting-resource attribution;no clean observer-free speed claim.
No physical262144/full-tail/RESTORE or ordinary runtime teardown qualification.

retention.preserved: Original selected engine+12fixtures;separate pending oneMKL capture/probe. No inference/runtime adoption.
retention.legacy_holds: This does not reconcile the14 older provenance holds.

prior_preparation_failure.boundary: Before root creation/model reads;compact historical record excludes models. Recover original15-asset map from1e676d554 and verify the8573 fingerprint. No native/model outcome relabelled.

placement_diagnostic.plan: One owned128/32K+ gate,then two separate observed117K processes:borrowed1256 then owned128;four fresh requests each,first separate. Fixed same6e40 binary/current runtime/math. Placement/cache geometry change together;order and observers prevent clean causal/adoption claims. Never change production decode. No retries or speed-based stopping.
placement_diagnostic.source_audit: 6e40 generate own_fits uses exact bytes_needed+512MiB;chunk fallback rejected by actual8192 route. Owned carve separately owns emb/R/region;borrowed lease uses checked tail. Native admission forbids lease1 with no-prefill-borrow,so owned-only uses lease0 for its independently owned buffers;borrowed keeps lease1. Shared long-pass GPU BF16/mode10 and48-layer dense restore must match. Same runtime safety/queue/parameter validation. Actual all-GPU residual allocation verified per request;32K gate does not establish117K or262144 capacity.
placement_diagnostic.limits: Diagnostic only. No clean speed,observer overhead,hardware saturation,task/decode performance,physical262144 or ordinary-runtime-teardown qualification.
placement_diagnostic.retention: At closed replay,keep all useful request clocks/work/placement/host summaries;retire normal logs,raw sampling,JIT and single-use controller. Selected engine+12fixtures and separate pending oneMKL consumer remain.
